# Text field (`text-field`)

Text input: eyebrow or floating label, adornments, validation, counter.

Group: Text inputs. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/text-inputs';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createTextField` (types in `dist/web/text-inputs/textField.d.ts`): `.mh-input` (`--sm | --lg`) inside a `.mh-field`: a single-line text input with an optional icon, prefix, suffix and counter. States: `:focus-within`, `[aria-invalid]`, `:disabled`. Height follows `--mh-control-*`.

```ts
export function createTextField(options: TextFieldOptions): TextFieldHandle;

export interface TextFieldOptions {
  /** Visible label. Without one, pass `ariaLabel`; the field then renders the box alone. */
  label?: string;
  ariaLabel?: string;
  value?: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  type?: TextFieldType;
  name?: string;
  helper?: string;
  error?: string;
  success?: string;
  required?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  readOnly?: boolean;
  size?: InputSize;
  labelStyle?: 'label' | 'eyebrow';
  /** A leading icon (decorative). */
  icon?: IconName | string;
  /** Text before the value, e.g. a currency sign. */
  prefix?: string;
  /** Text after the value, e.g. a unit. */
  suffix?: string;
  maxLength?: number;
  /** Shows a character counter (with `maxLength`, `n / max`). */
  showCount?: boolean;
  autocomplete?: string;
  inputMode?: string;
  onInput?: (value: string, event: Event) => void;
  onChange?: (value: string, event: Event) => void;
}

export interface TextFieldHandle {
  /** The field (or the bare box without a label). */
  el: HTMLElement;
  input: HTMLInputElement;
  field: FieldHandle | null;
  getValue(): string;
  setValue(value: string): void;
  setError(text: string | undefined): void;
  setHelper(text: string | undefined): void;
  setSuccess(text: string | undefined): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}

export interface FieldHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  label: HTMLLabelElement | HTMLSpanElement;
  /** The described element (input, select, textarea or the control). */
  target: HTMLElement;
  setHelper(text: string | undefined): void;
  setError(text: string | undefined): void;
  setSuccess(text: string | undefined): void;
  /** Updates the counter: `3 / 40` with a max, `3` without. */
  setCount(count: number, max?: number): void;
  /** Dims the label and messages (the control disables itself). */
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createTextField } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const room = createTextField({
  label: 'Room name',
  placeholder: 'e.g. Kitchen',
  helper: 'Shown on tiles and in voice replies.',
  maxLength: 24,
  showCount: true,
  onChange: (value) => room.setError(value.trim() ? undefined : 'Give the room a name.'),
});

document.body.append(room.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { TextField } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function TextFieldExample() {
  const [room, setRoom] = useState('');
  const [touched, setTouched] = useState(false);
  return (
    <TextField
      label="Room name"
      placeholder="e.g. Kitchen"
      helper="Shown on tiles and in voice replies."
      error={touched && !room.trim() ? 'Give the room a name.' : undefined}
      maxLength={24}
      showCount
      value={room}
      onChange={(event) => setRoom(event.target.value)}
      onBlur={() => setTouched(true)}
    />
  );
}
```
